question: What class of practice is being closed off here as having been told, with hair-pore and related items marking its locus?
premises: An anaphoric pronoun refers to a preceding instruction.
Hair-pore and related items are named as loci/open markers.
The content is named as kaula practice.
inference: Kaula practice relating to the hair-pore and so on has been told to the goddess.
uncertainties: The specific techniques of that practice are not recapitulated in this verse.
plain_english: O goddess, this kaula practice relating to the hair-pore and so on has been told to you.
